content.short: Lighthouse is a crosschain portfolio terminal for crypto pros and teams.
content.description: Lighthouse unifies crypto activity across dozens of wallets, chains, and exchanges into a single, comprehensive portfolio. Connect on-chain wallets and centralized exchanges to bring every account into one view, so you can track overall performance, exposures, and risk with precision. Use the built-in tools for transfers and swaps to act quickly from a single dashboard. Supported chains include Ethereum, Solana, Bitcoin, Cosmos, Aptos, Sui, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Base, Polygon, BNB Chain, and Avalanche.
